FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'

calls.statement:
WITH x AS (
SELECT r.*, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', r.return_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS hel_date, f.quantity AS sold_q, f.sale_date, f.product_key AS sold_pk
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
WHERE p.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-20' AND DATE '2026-09-10')
SELECT count(*) n, count(distinct return_line_id) ids, count(distinct sales_line_id) sl, sum(CASE WHEN hel_date<>return_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) datemis,
 sum(CASE WHEN sold_q IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nosale, sum(CASE WHEN quantity_returned>sold_q THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) overq, min(quantity_returned) mn, max(quantity_returned) mx,
 sum(CASE WHEN return_date<sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale, sum(CASE WHEN sold_pk<>product_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pkdiff
FROM x

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  AND cp.category = 'Garden' AND cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND s.store_id <> 999
GROUP BY 1, 2
